rows.en: (Okay, school's over, so time to head home.)
(Oh, it's Hoshimura.)
Hey, Hoshimura. Heading home now?

Huh! How'd you know I was about
to go home, \p!?
C-could it be... you like me...?

(Well, she's walking out the school gate
right now, so anyone would figure that...)

Well, jokes aside...
You're heading home too, right, \p?
Then how about walking home with me?
Sure, I'd love to......
rows.notes: Shared male/female. Cut off by Yui.

rows.en:
Wait, aaaaaaah!!
Today's junk sale day in Deep Akihabara!

Sorry, \p!
I'm going on ahead!!
Definitely ask me again sometime! Bye!

(Hoshimura took off like a shot...
Oh well, guess I'll head home alone today...)
(Oh, it's Yui.)
Yui, are you heading home now?

(Well, she's walking out the school gate
right now, so of course anyone would think that...)

(Yui took off like a shot...
Oh well, I'll just have to head home
alone today...)
(Whoa~, the Sky Gate sure is big.)

(For a concert by the Galactic Fairy,
even a place this big would probably
fill up in no time.)

Whatcha doin' in a place like thiiis,
\p?

Oh, hey, Hoshimura.
I was just passing by.
What about you, Hoshimura?

Mm~, I was in the neighborhood too,
so I just stopped by.
Whew~, but this really brings back memories.

Brings back memories?
Do you have some memory of the Sky Gate?

Yup. This was back when I was a hugely
popular idol who could sing and dance...

I held my farewell concert here at the Sky Gate.
And then I retired from show business...

Y-you don't have to look at me so coldly!
It was just a little joke!

Geez, this person really can't take a joke...
Hmph! I've got nothing to do here,
so I'm going home.

Yeah, see you,
self-proclaimed former superstar idol.

Ahh... All this cruelty,
just because I told one lame joke......
Oh well. See ya, then.

(Haha, just talking nonsense with Hoshimura
is a nice change of pace.)
(Wow~, the Sky Gate sure is big.)

(For a concert by the Galactic Fairy,
even a place this big would
fill up in no time.)

Oh, Yui.
I was just passing by.
What about you, Yui?

Brings back memories?
Do you have some memory of the Sky Gate?

Yeah, see you,
self-proclaimed former superstar idol.

(Heh, just talking nonsense with Yui
is a nice change of pace.)

(Sigh... Hilda-sensei's class was
as brutal as ever...)

Fwaaah~, that water felt great~
Oho? If it isn't \p!

Heh heh heh, well? What do you think of me,
fresh from the shower and oozing sex appeal?
Uh, you look pretty much the same as always...

Mmph~, what a boring reaction~!
Seems I need to show you just how much
sex appeal I've got hidden away!!

See, I just shampooed, so
I smell super nice, right?
Take a sniff, take a sniff.
Whoa, you're too close! Hoshimura!?
Fweh?

Wha! Ah...... Sorry!
S-see ya!!
(Hoshimura got embarrassed and ran off...)

(Usually she has fun watching me panic.
What on earth got into her?)

(Sigh... Hilda-sensei's class was
as brutal as ever...)
Whoa, you're too close! Yui!?
(Yui got embarrassed and ran off...)

(Usually she has fun watching me panic.
What on earth got into her?)

(I'm getting hungry anyway,
so maybe I'll grab a hot dog.)

Well, well, fancy meeting you here,
\p.

Hey, Hoshimura.
Did you come for a hot dog too?

You got it~
The hot dogs here are top-notch,
so I come by every now and then.

Huh~
Come to think of it, you like junk food,
don't you, Hoshimura?

I can eat it while I tinker with machines.
It's easy, so what's not to like?
That's such a Hoshimura reason.

Right, right?
Okay, once we've finished these, shall we
be off to Deep Akihabara or someplace?
That's pretty sudden...

Well, of course!
I only just thought of it myself.
All right! Away we go!

(As usual, the moment she thinks of something,
she's off doing it.)

(Well, tagging along with Hoshimura
should be a nice change of pace too.)

(I'm getting hungry anyway,
so maybe I'll grab a hot dog.)

Oh, Yui.
Did you come for a hot dog too?

Huh~
Come to think of it, you like junk food,
don't you, Yui?
That's such a Yui reason.
That's pretty sudden...

(As usual, the moment she thinks of something,
she's off doing it.)

(Well, tagging along with Yui
should be a nice change of pace too.)

(As usual, the moment she thinks of something,
she's off doing it.)
rows.notes: Male. Spelling variant of c14905 (soku in kana).

uncertain: c14880: ii oyu datta (said after a bath) rendered "that water felt great" since she has just showered after class.
c14869/c14877: jishou moto dai-ninki aidoru-san rendered "self-proclaimed former superstar idol" (the -san here is mock-polite, not a name honorific, so dropped).
